Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000984": INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000714": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000448" [decision]: The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000710": INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000988": The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys.  (about: INC-2026-003, the retry loop, idempotency keys)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000451": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000575": INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000434": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, the schema migration)
- memory_id "1000579": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000581" [decision]: Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review.  (about: INC-2025-017, certificate expiry)
- memory_id "1000836": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000994" [decision]: The webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, a follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003, idempotency keys)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000495" [decision]: As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000491": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler's runbook.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
Existing entity names: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003, INC-2025-023, reindex jobs, Ember team, job scheduler, indexer, ledger service, INC-2025-011, the retry loop, idempotency keys, notifier, auth gateway, INC-2025-017, the schema migration, certificate expiry, Boreal team, the runtime upgrade, billing API, the bus, reporting service, team Dune, Farah, Oskar, Cinder team

The note:

[2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.

"[2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009."

New entities: INC-2026-009, the scheduler (likely alias for job scheduler), nightly jobs, the scheduler leader lease.

Facts:
1. INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Entities: INC-2026-009, job scheduler (via alias "the scheduler"), nightly jobs.
2. The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. Entities: INC-2026-009.
3. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. Entities: the scheduler leader lease, job scheduler.

Relations: The scheduler depends_on? Hmm. The decision relates to the scheduler leader lease. Maybe add relation: job scheduler depends_on the scheduler leader lease? Or the scheduler leader lease... Actually relations should be between two entities. The note states the scheduler leader lease is the scheduler's lease. Could add "job scheduler depends_on the scheduler leader lease"? That might be inventing. The decision is about the lease. Maybe relation: INC-2026-009... hmm.

Alias: "the scheduler" -> "job scheduler". Also "scheduler leader lease" is a new entity.

Relations: maybe "INC-2026-009" relates to... The root cause relation isn't a relation between entities per se. Perhaps add relation: job scheduler depends_on the scheduler leader lease (evidence: "the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds"). Hmm, that's a bit of a stretch but reasonable: the scheduler uses a leader lease. Actually the note says "two leaders elected during a network partition" — implies leader election. The existing decision memory 1000448 says job scheduler will use leader election. The lease is part of leader election. I could add relation: job scheduler depends_on the scheduler leader lease. I think that's acceptable but could be considered inventing. Let me be conservative but relations are useful. The instruction: "Add one for each relationship the note states." The note states the scheduler has a leader lease. That's a relationship between scheduler and lease. I'll add depends_on.

Evidence quotes:
- Fact 1: "The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16."
- Fact 2: "Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition."
- Fact 3: "the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds"

Alias: "the scheduler" -> "job scheduler". Evidence: "The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice".

Should I also alias "nightly jobs"? No existing entity for that. New entity.

Confidence: 1.0 or 0.95.

Kinds: fact, fact, decision.

Output JSON only.
